_README_HOW_TO_ADD_A_PHOTO: 1. Upload the image to the repo ROOT, named ac<NUMBER>.webp  (e.g. ac9.webp).
2. Use the NEXT number up from the highest that exists. Higher number = shows FIRST.
3. Copy one full { ... } block from the 'slides' list below.
4. Paste it at the BOTTOM of the 'slides' list (just append - no need to reorder).
5. Change image, alt, and caption. Order sorts itself by the ac-number automatically.
6. JSON RULE: put a comma after every } EXCEPT the last one in the list.
